# Project Monet

[Project Monet](https://www.projectmonet.space/) is a website design studio for local businesses in India and internationally.

Contact: [contact@projectmonet.space](mailto:contact@projectmonet.space)
Phone: +91-8290096163

## Core offer

See your website before you pay.

Project Monet can create a small free homepage concept before a paid website project begins. The free demo is a direction preview, not a complete website, and it does not include revisions or commercial usage rights.

## Pricing

- Starter Website: ₹20,000 for Indian clients / $299 for international clients
- Business Website: ₹35,000 for Indian clients / $499 for international clients
- Growth Website: ₹55,000+ for Indian clients / $799+ for international clients

INR and USD are separate regional pricing tracks. Domain, hosting, paid tools, add-ons and maintenance are charged separately. Standard payment terms are 50% advance and 50% before launch and handover.

## Founder context

Project Monet is founded and led by Mayank Harsh in Gurgaon, India. Mayank's personal creator track record includes more than 35 million organic views, more than 102,000 combined followers and five-plus originated trend formats. These are founder credentials, not Project Monet client results. Project Monet publishes client outcomes separately only when they are real, supportable and approved for use.

## Ownership

After final payment, the client owns the completed website, content and available custom code/files included in the agreement, along with relevant domain, hosting and platform access. Third-party products remain subject to their own licences. Maintenance is optional.

## Accuracy rules

Project Monet does not guarantee search rankings, leads, calls, sales, revenue, medical outcomes, property returns or other business results. It does not use fabricated clients, testimonials, ratings or statistics. Useful information comes before promotion.
